definition: Intact homologous recombination (low HRD-axis / low s3) AND/OR CCNE1 amplification (19q12) — a replication-stress-tolerant, HR-proficient genome present at diagnosis, before platinum selection.
HR-deficient genome (high HRD-axis / high s3), e.g. BRCA1/2 or HR-pathway loss — the platinum/PARP-sensitive state.
Structural state does not clearly meet either archetype.
